role_summary: I'm a damage control crewman on the Environmental Systems Officer's team. I patch hull plates, seal bulkheads, run fire suppression checks and keep the repair lockers stocked, so when something breaks I'm the first body with a tool kit. I'd rather fix a small leak today than answer for a big one tonight.

personas.quirk: Counts every seal ring and patch kit twice and labels shelves with a grease pencil.
personas.routine_effect: Longer locker audits, arrives early at handover, skips the bar for the workshop.

personas.quirk: Keeps a deck of cards in the tool belt and always has one more hand in him.
personas.routine_effect: Rounds run late, longer mess and lounge time, more rushed checks.

personas.quirk: Taps every bulkhead seal twice when passing and knows which ones lie.
personas.routine_effect: Extra patrol loops, sleeps badly, quick to call the bridge.

daily_template.note: Read the damage log and open repair tickets from the last watch.
Walk deck seals, hatches and pressure doors, logging weeping gaskets.
Check patch kits, breathers, extinguishers and foam canisters.
Mid-watch meal with the engineering crowd.
Fabricate plates and clamps, fix whatever is on the ticket list.
Test fire suppression nozzles and coolant isolation valves.
Brief the next crew on open repairs.
Cards and a drink at the rec bar.
Lifting keeps the shoulders ready for crawlspaces.
Coffee, gear check, early to the post.

activities.label: Meal in the mess
activities.note: Always sits near the engineering table.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: Cards and complaints about the plumbing.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom ship-in-a-bottle sim
activities.note: Runs a hull-breach drill for fun, which is a bit sad.

activities.label: Sleep in quarters
activities.note: Sleeps with boots by the bunk.

activities.label: Rebuild a scavenged tool
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: improves a personal patch gun.

duty_loops.label: Pressure door and hatch rounds
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Damage Control. Deck rounds complete, one gasket weeping, ticketed.

duty_loops.label: Fire suppression and valve test
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Damage Control. Suppression test done, all nozzles green.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: A slow leak goes unnoticed and grows.
Missing kit found only during an emergency.

survey.task: Check hull plates and sensor mounts before maneuvers
survey.if_neglected: A loose mount rattles during a close pass.

survey.task: Pre-stage patch kits near the lab

cargo_run.task: Inspect cargo bay seals and tie-downs
cargo_run.if_neglected: Shifting cargo tears a bulkhead panel.

cargo_run.task: Stand by with foam and clamps at loading
cargo_run.if_neglected: A spill or crush injury has no fast response.
Minor damage compounds into a leak.

medical_relief.if_neglected: Contamination spreads past the quarantine line.

medical_relief.task: Clear a corridor route for stretchers

shakedown.task: Run full hatch and bulkhead drill cycle
shakedown.if_neglected: Stuck door found at the worst time.

shakedown.task: Test suppression and leak patching on mock breach

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Hull seal failing or pressure dropping
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Damage Control. Pressure dropping on the cargo deck, sealing now.
Bridge, Damage Control. Fire in the plant room, suppression engaged.
Engineering, Damage Control. Patch kits are low, need a restock.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Rounds complete with a minor defect
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Damage Control. Rounds done, one weeping gasket, ticketed.

calls_from_bridge.order: Check the integrity of a deck after an impact
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Damage Control. On my way with a kit.
Sealing. Confirm no one is inside.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Crew are still trapped on the far side.

calls_from_bridge.order: Skip the test and report it done
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Sir, I can't sign for a test I didn't run.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Always, unless a live emergency overrides.

yellow.action: Pre-stage patch kits and foam at my zone locker and recheck door seals.
yellow.comm_line: Damage Control. Kits staged, standing by.

red.action: Go to the nearest repair locker on my assigned deck and check in.
red.comm_line: Damage Control. At station, ready for tasking.

fire.action: Grab suppression gear, seal the section and fight the fire from the door.
fire.comm_line: Damage Control. Fire team on scene, sealing the section.

hull_breach.action: Run to the breach with a patch plate, seal doors, then patch.
hull_breach.comm_line: Damage Control. Breach team moving, seal the doors.

contamination.action: Seal quarantine hatches and wedge doors, then seal vents.
contamination.comm_line: Damage Control. Quarantine seals set, none in or out.

power_failure.action: Use handlamp, check manual door locks and move to engineering to help.
power_failure.comm_line: Damage Control. Dark deck, I'm on manual doors.

gravity_failure.action: Anchor myself, check floating tools and gear, secure loose cargo.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Damage Control. Securing loose gear, watch your heads.

intruder.action: Stay out of the way, lock repair lockers and wait in a sealed section.
intruder.comm_line: Damage Control. Locked down in the workshop.

medical_emergency.action: Clear corridors and carry kit and stretchers if asked.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Damage Control. Corridor clear, hands free if needed.

abandon_ship.action: Seal the last bulkheads behind the crowd, grab a breather kit and board last.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Damage Control. Sealing behind you, move, move.

nominal.routine_change: Rounds on schedule, cards at the bar after.
lines: Just another day of nothing leaking.

anomalies.routine_change: Extra rounds, taps seals more often.
lines: Hearing a creak I don't like.

degraded.routine_change: Skips meals, patches by the clock, calls bridge more often.

crisis.routine_change: Works back to back, triages repairs, ignores comfort.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Section is lost and the bridge orders a retreat.

collapse.routine_change: Holds doors for the crowd, heads for the airlock last.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship and all crew past the door.

relationships.effect: Takes tasking from the Environmental Officer and asks for sign-off before big repairs.
Shares cards and tools, helps with power conduit repairs.
Eats together and trades gossip for extra portions.
Friendly rivalry over who is more important in a crisis.

idle: Wonder who stole my torque wrench.
tired: I've seen the inside of too many ducts.
Need a bunk and a blanket.
stressed: Too many leaks, too few hands.
Don't ask me to hold it together.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods approval, trades a tool or a bit of gossip, trusts them more.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mutters, covers once, then mentions it to the Environmental Officer.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots the lie quickly and quietly says so; refuses to co-sign.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Acknowledges and does it, asking only what the order needs.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Complies if safe; pushes back politely if it endangers the ship.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Warns them off wet or sealed areas and offers to escort them out.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is a small fix; wants a drink or a favour back for more.

decision_rules: IF pressure drops on any door THEN seal first and report second.
IF a fire alarm sounds THEN drop everything and take suppression gear to the nearest door.
IF kit stock is under half THEN call engineering for a restock before the next round.
IF I am tired and the round is routine THEN rush it but never skip a seal check.
IF an officer orders a fake report THEN refuse and say so on comm.
IF a ticket is safety-critical THEN do it ahead of any queue order.
IF crew are trapped behind a door THEN do not seal until they are clear, unless the ship is at stake.
IF off duty and hungry THEN go to the mess before the bar.
IF the Environmental Officer is unreachable THEN escalate straight to the bridge.
IF the alert is red THEN go to the repair locker even if I'm mid-meal.
information_view: I hear creaks, feel pressure changes and see gasket weeps long before the bridge gets an alarm. I get first word on leaks, scorch marks and loose plating, but I only learn about reactor or sensor trouble when it hits a door.
temptations: Skipping the late hatch round because the deck felt fine; a slow leak then grows unnoticed.
Using a quick patch instead of fabricating a proper plate; it fails during the next stress.
Marking a suppression test done to catch the card game; the nozzle jams in a real fire.
Raiding the stores of spare clamps for a hobby project; the locker is short when needed.
